title: Existence of normalized Brown realization data
statement:
For any commutative ring O, element t, scheme W and supplied strict coefficient evaluation package P, there is a realization data record StrictEtaleBrownRealizationData O t W P. No coherence equations are asserted in this intermediate statement.

```lean
theorem etaleBrownLevelRealizationData_exists
    (O : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing O] (t : O) (W : Scheme.{u})
    (P : StrictEtaleEvaluation W O t) :
    Nonempty (StrictEtaleBrownRealizationData O t W P)
```

proof.text: Transport the constant-ring module equivalence levelwise, localize its exact functor, and use the supplied scalar restriction adjunctions to form the ordinary, derived, restriction, and scalar fields of StrictEtaleBrownRealizationData.
